description: Opens the multi-value fixture read-only and asks: database and TableDef metadata, every Field2 property of T (including IsComplex and each Properties entry), the TypeInfo of the Tags Field2 and of the child recordset it returns, the child recordset's own properties, its Fields (all Field2 properties), cursor movement and RecordCount before and after MoveLast, ParentRecordset, then the group of each parent (p1..p6, a filler, the deleted p5) read to EOF; and the catalog: MSysComplexColumns and MSysObjects rows.
retentionNote: Designed r-cplx-rebuild probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
